challenges.pre_battle_dialogue: Zephyra spreads her arms into the wind. 'The Gale Badge isn't won by force — it's earned by balance. Show me you can read the currents, not fight them.'
challenges.victory_dialogue: 'You listened to the wind. Take the Gale Badge — you've earned it.' Zephyra smiles as banners snap in the gust behind her.
challenges.defeat_dialogue: Zephyra lowers her hand gently. 'The wind pushed you off rhythm. Let's pause — I'll show you how Flying types use the gusts. Ready when you are.'
challenges.notes: Battle format: 2 Pokémon per trainer. Environmental effect: strong winds. Special rule — each round, Flying-type Pokémon gain +1 initiative (wind initiative). On failure, Zephyra pauses and teaches strategy before retry (fail-soft). Recommended team: Pidgeotto (lv11), Swablu (lv11), signature Tropius (lv13).
